newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Gov says keeping tolls flat will aid economy.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Gov says keeping tolls flat will aid economy.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki said Wednesday the state Thruway Authority's decision not to raise the tolls paid by drivers for the foreseeable future will help strengthen the economy.
"The decision not to increase tolls will help continue our economic renewal, particularly upstate," Pataki said, in prepared remarks.

Expressing confidence in the Authority's leadership, Pataki added the decision to not hike tolls was consistent with his Administration's efforts to cut taxes, energy rates and state spending, while also curbing the regulatory burden on businesses and local governments.
